title: La Leaderboard: A Large Language Model Leaderboard for Spanish Varieties and Languages of Spain and Latin America

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring stereotype generation and detection using the Crows-Pairs datasets adapted for Spanish and Catalan (evaluated via the pct_stereotype metric).

Benchmarking and comparing LLM capabilities across multiple languages (Spanish, Catalan, Basque, Galician) and regional language varieties to assess linguistic disparities and cultural representation.
